about_the_game:
【Rhythm & Dance Gameplay】

With a massive music library, you can dance freely to the beat and show off your talent, enjoying the thrill and excitement of rhythm-based competition. Featuring a brand-new note drop system and satisfying gameplay feel, the game also supports user-generated charts, making you feel like you're on a real dance stage as you embark on a journey full of challenges and surprises.

【Extensive Song Library】

The game offers a rich selection of songs covering a wide range of genres including pop, rock, electronic, and classics — from casual and relaxing to intense and challenging. Each track is carefully selected and arranged to deliver the most rhythmically immersive experience. As you level up, you'll unlock more iconic songs, taking on fresh music challenges and enjoying new performance experiences!

【Fashion DIY】

In addition to crafting outfits, you can also set up your own DIY fashion studio in the town and create your own unique clothing for free! With a variety of materials, stickers, accessories, and tools provided in-game, you can unleash your creativity to design custom high-fashion pieces. What kind of look will you create for your stage? Let your imagination run wild!

【Romantic Bonds】

Meet that special someone through dancing and adventure. Dance together, explore together, and unlock exclusive interactions and sweet rewards. As your bond deepens, you can even hold a romantic ceremony under the stars and start a journey that belongs only to the two of you.

【Social Interaction】

In Starry Town, surprises and mysteries await around every corner. Ride various mounts to explore floating islands with different styles, and interact freely with anyone you wish. Experience the changing day and night cycle and enjoy a peaceful, leisurely life.

name: Idol Party 2

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i7-7700
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i7-8700
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: As the full upgrade to Idol Party, Idol Party 2 is a casual game that combines fashion styling, rhythm gameplay, and social interaction. Mix and match trendy outfits, dance and compete with friends, meet your soulmate on the dance floor, and step into a romantic wedding ceremony!
supported_languages:
English*, Simplified Chinese*, Traditional Chinese
*languages with full audio support
